fields.description: Address Frappe Cloud hands to Suite sites so they can reach this Suite Cloud, e.g. https://cloud.frappemail.com. Leave blank to use this site's own URL.
fields.label: Public URL

fields.description: Every request from a Suite site runs as this user. It is created on install and needs no changes.
fields.label: Site Service User

fields.description: Take a tenant site's word for its domains: add them without the TXT record that proves control, and treat them as verified without checking their DNS records. For a development cloud, whose test domains exist in no public DNS. Never on a shared cluster: a wrongly claimed domain locks its owner out, and Stalwart accepts mail for every domain marked verified. Turning it off re-checks the domains it vouched for.
fields.label: Skip Domain Verification

fields.description: How long fetched DMARC reports are kept; empty means 90 days. Stalwart drops its own copy after 30 days, so this is the only history a site sees.
fields.label: DMARC Report Retention (Days)

fields.description: How long fetched TLS reports are kept; empty means 90 days. Stalwart drops its own copy after 30 days, so this is the only history a site sees.
fields.label: TLS Report Retention (Days)

fields.description: Stalwart release that new clusters install, e.g. v0.16.20. Existing clusters keep their own version until you run Upgrade Nodes on them.
fields.label: Stalwart Version

fields.description: Where the node downloads the Stalwart archive from. {version} is replaced with the release and {target} with the platform, e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
fields.label: Stalwart Download URL Template

fields.description: Release of Stalwart's spam filter rules a cluster imports on its first start, e.g. v3.0.1. Newer rules can use expression functions an older server lacks, so change it together with the Stalwart Version. Empty imports the latest release.
fields.label: Spam Filter Rules Version

fields.description: Release of stalwart-cli installed next to the server, e.g. v1.0.12. Only used on a node while it bootstraps a cluster.
fields.label: Stalwart CLI Version

fields.description: Where the node downloads the stalwart-cli archive from. Same placeholders as the server URL, but {target} is the static build, e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.
fields.label: Stalwart CLI Download URL Template

fields.description: Every domain gets an RSA key (selector frappemail-rsa); check this to add an Ed25519 key as well (selector frappemail-ed25519). Off by default because many receivers still ignore Ed25519 signatures and treat the mail as unsigned. Keys are generated and held by the cluster and never rotate. Applies to domains registered on Stalwart after the change, the cluster default domain included; existing domains keep the keys they were created with.
fields.label: Sign with Ed25519 as well as RSA

fields.description: Certificate authority clusters request their TLS certificates from. While testing use https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory to avoid rate limits; staging certificates are not trusted by mail clients.
fields.label: ACME Directory URL

fields.description: Address the certificate authority writes to about expiring certificates. Used by clusters that do not set their own contact.
fields.label: ACME Contact Email

fields.description: How long resolvers may cache the records Suite Cloud publishes, used when a DNS Zone sets no TTL of its own. Also suggested to sites for their domain records. 300 keeps node changes quick to roll out.
fields.label: Default DNS TTL (Seconds)
